spanish: Y ahora, envía, haz refugiar a tu ganado y a todo lo que a ti en el campo; todo el hombre y el ganado que se halle en el campo y no se recoja a la casa, y descenderá sobre ellos el granizo y morirán.

findings.issue: «haz refugiar» can be read as the addressee causing an unnamed person to shelter the livestock; the hiphil imperative 2ms has the addressee cause the livestock to be brought to safety.
«todo el hombre» is naturally read as the whole of one man; כל with singular האדם stays open between every man and all the people.

notes: Other clauses track the tokens, including verbless אשר לך, niphal singulars, directional הביתה, and weqatal futures.
